verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's marketing docs describe automatic onboarding and offboarding workflows, HRIS-driven provisioning and deprovisioning, identity lifecycle automation, and conditional access that revokes access with no manual intervention. These are policy-driven automations that run in the background. Beyond that, custom automation depends on scripting against the APIs or PowerShell module for bulk operations, with no evidence of a user-configurable background automation or agent framework. Missing for 10: a documented scheduler or trigger-based workflow builder for custom background automations, AI or agent-driven autonomous actions, in-depth first-party docs beyond marketing pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
